newsitem.title: USA: Reliv Int'l U.S. December sales up 72 pct.
newsitem.headline: Reliv Int'l U.S. December sales up 72 pct.

text.p: Reliv International Inc, which makes and markets nutritional supplements, said Wednesday that its U.S. sales during December rose more than 72 percent from the same month a year ago.
Fourth quarter sales in the U.S. increased 71 percent over a year ago to $9.1 million, while sales for all of 1996 were up 41.6 percent to $31 million, Reliv said in a statement.
U.S. sales account for about 75 percent of the company's total sales. Reliv has operations in Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Canada and Mexico.
Sales in the U.S. benefited from new products, new marketing programs designed to produce add-on sales, and improved recruitment of distributors, the company said.
"It was an outstanding year for Reliv and our distributors," said Robert Montgomery, chairman and president, in a statement. "We're working hard to make sure our sales momentum continues into 1997."
Sales results for the company's foreign subsidiaries are not yet available.
